Eliza noticed Maya’s hesitation and approached her gently. "Welcome to Whispering Pages," she said with a warm smile. "What brings you here today?"

Maya looked up, a bit surprised but pleased by the greeting. "I’m just looking for something to read. I’ve been missing my old library back home, but I haven’t found anything quite right yet."

Eliza nodded understandingly. "I can help with that. What kind of stories do you usually enjoy?" she asked, leading Maya to a section of mystery novels.

As they walked, Eliza shared her insights about different genres, pointing out titles that might appeal to Maya. She suggested a few contemporary thrillers, some classic detective stories, and even a few lesser-known works that Eliza thought might capture Maya’s interest.

Maya hesitated, then shook her head. "I don’t think so. I’ve never really found it my thing."

Eliza smiled reassuringly. "Sometimes, it’s worth giving a poem a chance. Let me show you this one. It’s by Elizabeth Bishop. I think it speaks to the journey we all go through—finding our place in the world."
